data.source_title: Tool 3: How To Deliver the Re-Engineered Discharge at Your Hospital
data.locator: Workflow steps 4–6, sections “Confer With the In-Hospital Medical Team” and “Arrange To Meet With Patient, Family, and Other Caregivers”
data.source_setting: AHRQ hospital discharge toolkit; U.S. hospital re-engineered discharge workflow.
data.source_period: Toolkit page accessed 2026-10-10; source page does not state a local implementation period.
data.quantity: Discharge planning and placement coordination domains
value: coordinate with case manager to obtain durable medical equipment
assess home social support and arrange needed home services with the team/case managers
communicate expected discharge date and concerns with inpatient team
prepare and teach after-hospital care plan
transmit discharge summary and plan to accepting clinicians
data.source_evidence_basis: AHRQ assigns case-manager collaboration for equipment and home services and describes care-team communication, social-support assessment, plan preparation/teaching, and information transfer.
data.limitations: This toolkit distinguishes a discharge educator from a case manager and is not a universal social-work or post-acute placement policy. Eligibility, payer authorization, facility acceptance, and local referral procedures are site-specific.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Model discharge readiness as dependent on discrete social-support, equipment, home-service or post-acute referral, acceptance, and communication tasks when applicable; do not infer that every patient needs placement.
